column1: # Production timings of `panvar genotype --profile profiles/genotype_c4.tsv` on an Apple M4 (4 performance +
# 6 efficiency cores), one call at a time, 8 threads; measured at b754647 (30x, 10x) and b754647+record (5x, 2x),
# which differ only in a status key. Read by tests/genotype_production_c4_campaign.sh plan for its estimate.
#   seconds_per_job   30x: mean of NA20509 LOO 442.1, NA19240 LOO 360.4, NA20509 LZO 309.4, bridgeable 384.1
#                     2x: NA20509 LOO 26.3 -- a LOWER BOUND: that run stopped after one round on a tie among
#                     improving neighbours (REPAIR_INCOMPLETE), so a converged 2x call would take longer
#   bytes_per_job     the call's outputs plus that job's regenerated reads (the per-donor LOO graph, ~3.4 MB,
#                     is shared across a donor's coverages and is not included)
#   peak_footprint    the largest measured at that coverage; 30x is NA20509 LOO 2569194208, and NA19240 LOO
#                     30x refused at the 2684354560 limit in one run and peaked at 2438105848 in another
